info.name: ABDM V3 — Complete API Collection
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman collection covering ALL ABDM V3 API endpoints across M1 (ABHA), M2 (HIP), and M3 (HIU) milestones.

Includes authentication, discovery, linking, consent, data flow, profile share, and bridge management.

Sandbox: https://dev.abdm.gov.in | ABHA: https://abhasbx.abdm.gov.in/abha/api
Production: https://apis.abdm.gov.in | ABHA: https://abha.abdm.gov.in/api/abha

Maintained by Nirmitee.io — https://nirmitee.io
Last updated: March 2026

item.name: Authentication

exec: console.log('Access token saved. Expires in', expiresIn, 'seconds.');

request.description:
Obtain an access token using your ABDM client credentials. The token is automatically saved to the `accessToken` environment variable.

**Status:** Working

**Token validity:** ~30 minutes (1800 seconds)

**Note:** The collection's pre-request script auto-refreshes the token before it expires. You only need to run this manually for initial setup or debugging.

item.description: Authentication endpoints. Get your access token before calling any other API.

item.name: M1 — ABHA Creation & Verification

request.description:
Request an OTP for ABHA enrollment. The OTP is sent to the mobile number linked with the Aadhaar number.

**Status:** Working

**Flow:**
1. Call this endpoint with Aadhaar number
2. User receives OTP on Aadhaar-linked mobile
3. Use the transactionId from response in subsequent enrollment calls

Complete ABHA enrollment using Aadhaar OTP verification.

**Status:** Working

**Prerequisites:** Must first call 'Request OTP for Enrollment' and have a valid transactionId.

Enroll for ABHA via ABDM (alternate enrollment method).

**Status:** Working

Request an OTP for logging into an existing ABHA account.

**Status:** Working

**loginHint values:** abha-number, abha-address, mobile
**otpSystem options:** abdm, aadhaar

Verify the OTP to complete ABHA login and get a profile token.

**Status:** Working

Download the ABHA card as a PNG or PDF.

**Status:** Working

**type options:** png, pdf

item.description:
M1 milestone: ABHA number creation, enrollment (Aadhaar/ABDM), profile login, and ABHA card download.

Base URL: {{abhaBaseUrl}}

item.name: M2 — HIP Services
Discovery & Linking

request.description:
**Direction:** Gateway → HIP (callback)
**Status:** Working

Payload format that ABDM sends to your HIP for patient discovery. V3 is SYNCHRONOUS — respond with care contexts in the HTTP response body.

**Direction:** HIP → Gateway
**Status:** Working

Send discovery response with matched patient and care contexts.

**Direction:** Gateway → HIP (callback)
**Status:** Working

Gateway initiates linking of selected care contexts. Your HIP should generate an OTP and respond via on-init.

**Direction:** HIP → Gateway
**Status:** Working

Respond to link init with a link reference and auth details.

**Direction:** Gateway → HIP (callback)
**Status:** Working

Gateway sends patient's OTP to confirm linking.

**Direction:** HIP → Gateway
**Status:** Working

Confirm that care contexts have been successfully linked.

item.description: User-initiated discovery and linking flow between patient PHR app, ABDM gateway, and your HIP.

item.name: M3 — HIU Services
Consent Management

**Status:** Working

Initiate a consent request to access patient health records.

**purpose.code values:** CAREMGT, BTG, PUBHLTH, HPAYMT, DSRCH, PATRQT
**hiTypes:** OPConsultation, Prescription, DiagnosticReport, DischargeSummary, ImmunizationRecord, HealthDocumentRecord, WellnessRecord

**Direction:** Gateway → HIU (callback)
**Status:** Working

**Direction:** HIU → Gateway
**Status:** Working

Check the current status of a consent request.

**Direction:** Gateway → HIU (callback)
**Status:** Working

Gateway returns consent status and artefact IDs.

**Direction:** HIU → Gateway
**Status:** Working

Fetch full consent artefact details.
